name: Cookie Butter Creamer Latte
flavor_notes: A quick, creamy cookie butter iced latte using Chobani Cookie Butter creamer and brown sugar with a Biscoff-coated rim.
barista_note: The fast-track cookie butter hack: instead of whipping cold foam from scratch, Chobani Cookie Butter creamer delivers rich speculoos flavor instantly. Smear a spoonful of Biscoff along the rim or inside the cup for cafe-style presentation.

variations.title: Sofia's Homemade Cloud Foam
variations.twist: Whips softened Biscoff with heavy cream and milk into an airy cold foam cloud poured over iced vanilla espresso.

variations.title: MainStMuse's Swirled Cup Latte
variations.twist: Drizzles melted Biscoff inside the glass and dissolves cookie butter directly into the hot instant espresso concentrate.

preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Equator Mocha Java
preparations.roast_note: Balanced nutty medium roast that harmonizes with brown sugar and sweet cookie butter creamer.

ingredients.item: Cometeer capsule, fully melted and chilled
Chobani Cookie Butter creamer (or sweet cream)
Speculoos / Biscoff cookie butter (for lining cup)

steps: Optionally smear 1 tsp of cookie butter around the inside walls or rim of a glass.
Add the brown sugar, cookie butter creamer, and cold whole milk; stir gently.
Pour the chilled Cometeer extract directly over the iced milk blend and stir.

preparations.tested_with: Nespresso Double Espresso Chiaro or Dolce
preparations.roast_note: Toasted cereal notes in Double Espresso Dolce pair smoothly with cookie butter spices.

ingredients.item: Nespresso Vertuo Double Espresso pod (Chiaro or Dolce)
Speculoos / Biscoff cookie butter (for lining cup)

steps: Optionally line the inside of your glass with a swirl of cookie butter.
Fill the glass with ice, then add brown sugar, cookie butter creamer, and cold milk.
Brew the Double Espresso pod directly over ice in a separate cup to cool slightly.
Pour the espresso over the iced creamer milk and stir to combine.

preparations.roast_note: A smooth blonde instant roast that lets the sweet cookie butter creamer shine without harsh bitterness.

ingredients.item: Speculoos / Biscoff cookie butter (for lining cup)

steps: In a small cup, dissolve 2 tsp instant espresso and 1 tsp brown sugar into 2 oz hot water.
Optionally smear 1 tsp of cookie butter along the inside of your serving glass.
Fill the glass with ice, then pour in 2 oz cookie butter creamer and 2 oz cold milk.
Pour the warm espresso concentrate over the iced creamer milk and stir well.
